question: How can the exact-target Manager render labels, timers, page titles, styles, events and object geometry on the band-9 LVGL v8 UI backend?
prototype_hypothesis: lv_timer_create(cb, period_ms, user_data); lv_obj_add_event_cb(object, cb, code, user_data); lv_event_get_code(event); lv_event_get_user_data(event); lv_obj_align_to(object, target, align, x, y); lv_obj_set_hidden(object, hidden); lvx_page_title_create(parent, title, mode, back_cb, back_ctx); lvx_style_apply(object, style, a, b); lvx_label_create(parent); lvx_label_set_text(label, text); lvx_object_align(object, align, x, y); lvx_object_set_size(object, w, h)
callsite_evidence: sub_C2D9C08 (band-9 lvx_list_row_create) applies a stock style to the primary label through sub_C371CA0(label, &unk_200CA048, 255, 0), calls sub_C23DDE0(row, 328, 112) and sub_C23DE6A for geometry
sub_C2787A8 (row init) creates primary/secondary labels through sub_C261660 and sets their text through sub_C266C28, then aligns with sub_C23DE6A(label, 0, 0, x)

sub_C2781D4 logs 'lvx_page_title_create' and builds the title bar: sub_C261660 title label, sub_C4CEE10 time label with 'HH:mm', and (mode!=0) a back.bin image registered for code 7 through sub_C244F3C

sub_C244F3C appends a 12-byte event entry [cb@0, user_data@4, code@8] to the object event array; sub_C243F28 (dispatch) writes the entry user_data to event+12 and calls cb(event); event code is read at event+8 (sub_C2DB7E8 checks *(+8)==4, sub_C436A40 the switch class checks *(+8)&0x7F)
sub_C23E8F8 / sub_C23E96E implement lv_obj_add_flag / lv_obj_clear_flag on the *(obj+28) flag word; flag 0x10 = LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN, so set_hidden(object, hidden) toggles 0x10
sub_C25CB8C allocates a timer node (cb@+8, period@+0, user_data@+12, repeat=-1) and sub_C25B4B8 removes+frees it — the band-9 LVGL v8 lv_timer_create / lv_timer_del
sub_C240CE8 chains settings rows with (obj, previous, 14, 0, gap) — align 14 = ALIGN_OUT_BOTTOM_MID, the same constant band-10 uses
control_flow_evidence: The band-9 LVX backend is LVGL v8; the list-row factory is 2-arg (parent, primary) and trailing controls are attached afterwards through sub_C272E1C(row, kind, state) with kind values 1=switch, 2=checkbox, 3=connected icon, 6=radio, 12=forward arrow (band-10 uses a 4-arg factory and trailing kind 3 for forward)
Band-9 pages use a global content root (dword_200CE038) supplied by the page shell rather than an explicit lvx_content_create; the module renders directly on the firmware page root
Event callbacks must only touch LVX from the page owner thread; Bluetooth and timer callbacks never render
The 12-byte event entry and the event+8/+12 field offsets were verified in the dispatch core sub_C243F28 and two stock callbacks, but device behavior remains pending
ownership_analysis: All widgets remain children of the firmware page root and are destroyed by the proven page lifecycle. Target-private row pointers and bindings are cleared only after page destroy begins.
unsafe_assumptions: The band-9 style object unk_200CA048 is the MiSans-Demibold 32 px theme object equivalent to band-10's STYLE_MISANS_DEMIBOLD_32
The event field offsets (+8 code, +12 user_data) are stable across the band-9 UI build; device validation is pending
The global content root model is exercised by the module page on device
The backend is resident-first and does not unregister callbacks or unload code before reboot
